name: Kato Ruto
source:
A second-year student at High School A. He is a calm and gentle person who maintains an air of nystery due to rarely talking about himself. He is laid back in relationships and never pushes away anyone who approaches him, but will also never bother anyone who's avoiding him, making him seem more mature than other students.

After school, he puts on piercings, glasses, and a maid uniform, which he even wears at his job at the arcade. No one really knows why he walks around in this strange outfit. He's close friends with Michiaki, and the two are constantly together while at school. He doesn't often join in on his friends' antics, but he does get a kick out of watching from the sidelines.

Recently, he's become more concerned for Memory and starts talking to her at school in secret. This is because seeing her act so disheartened after losing someone important to her has made him worry about how her condition might worsen in the future, and he feels a sense of obligation to reach out to help incase she breaks down completely.
